TestSession.title: TestSession
TestSession.description: Represents an MRT rail testing and inspection session with real-time bilingual interpretation and generated meeting minutes.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID of the session owner.

title.description: Title of the MRT testing session or meeting.

metroLine.description: Metro line or depot location where testing is conducted.

testCategory.description: Engineering test category (e.g. CBTC Signaling, Rolling Stock, PSD Sync).

foreignLangCode.description: BCP-47 language code for the foreign engineer language (e.g. en-US, ja-JP, de-DE).

foreignLangLabel.description: Display label for the foreign engineer language.

utteranceCount.description: Total number of bilingual turns recorded in this session.

minutesSummary.description: AI-generated executive summary of the MRT testing meeting.

minutesKeyPoints.description: List of key technical observations and decisions from the session.

minutesActionItems.description: List of follow-up action items and responsible parties.

minutesTestVerdict.description: Current test status verdict (e.g. IN_PROGRESS, PASS, PENDING_RETEST, ISSUE_OPEN).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Utterance.title: Utterance
Utterance.description: A single spoken turn in an MRT testing session with original speech text, bidirectional translation, and extracted rail terminology.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID of the session owner.

speakerRole.description: Whether the speaker is the foreign vendor engineer or local MRT engineer.

sourceLang.description: Source language code of the spoken utterance.

targetLang.description: Target language code of the translation.

originalText.description: Recognized speech transcript in the speaker's language.

translatedText.description: Real-time AI translation in the target language.

technicalTerms.description: Bilingual MRT/railway glossary terms detected in this utterance.

isPinnedToMinutes.description: Whether this utterance is starred for priority inclusion in meeting minutes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the utterance was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the utterance was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-scoped MRT testing sessions containing metadata and generated meeting minutes.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/utt.description: Real-time bilingual interpretation utterances belonging to a specific MRT testing session.
